comparison.objective: Sort only cast ballots into labeled trays; candidate separates physical media by size/shape.
comparison.physical_skill: Semantic classification and pick/place versus emergent physical screening of a mixed batch.
comparison.success_condition: Cast ballots correctly sorted and uncast ballot excluded versus media recovered and washers retained.
comparison.reason: Sorting is shared only at an abstract level; the candidate tests physical aperture separation, not label classification.
